_about: A model of one eventstream. sources lists each source with its fields and their data types. operators, derived_streams and destinations are keyed by name. Each operator and destination has an input (a source's, operator's or derived stream's name), and a Union has inputs, a list. Manage fields has fields, a list of {source_field, name, type}. It outputs only those fields, renaming source_field to name and changing it to type (String, Int64, Double, Boolean, DateTime). Group by has group_by (fields), aggregations ({function, field}, function Sum, Average, Minimum or Maximum) and a window with a type (Tumbling or Sliding) and minutes. An Eventhouse destination has an ingestion_mode, either "Direct ingestion" or "Event processing before ingestion". south_fields is a Manage fields operator that isn't connected yet. Fill it in if you need it.
needs: Both docks' readings go into one Lakehouse table, dock_readings, with the north dock's field names and types: EventTime, SensorId, TempC and DoorOpen.
The cold-chain dashboard reads the Eventhouse table sensor_temps, which holds each sensor's average TempC for each 5-minute block of time, one figure per block, with blocks that don't overlap.
The south dock's sensors are from another vendor, and their feed can't be changed.
symptom: Since the south dock went live, dock_readings has south rows with no temperature and SensorId empty, and sensor_temps shows no south sensors at all. The dashboard also shows several overlapping figures for each sensor.
